headline.zh:
验证前快照，
事后看清它改了什么。
headline.en:
Snapshot before verify,
audit what changed after.

sub.zh: worldcheck 是编码代理的测试世界检查点工具：给每个任务一份可播种的一次性测试世界，验证前打一个检查点，验证后列出文件与行级的变更，把「测试通过」变成可复核的证据。
sub.en: worldcheck is the test-world checkpoint tool for coding agents: a seeded disposable world per task, a checkpoint before verification, and a diff of what moved after it — turning the pass claim into auditable evidence.

title.zh: 可播种的一次性测试世界

body.zh: 一条命令从 compose.yml 加 seed.sql 拉起干净的世界，等数据库真的就绪再灌种子，并把种子清单与状态指纹记进 manifest.json。
body.en: One command stands up a clean world from compose.yml plus seed.sql, waits until the database really accepts connections, then records the seed manifest and state fingerprint into manifest.json.

title.zh: 验证前定格，验证后对账

body.zh: checkpoint 记下每个容器的文件基线与数据库快照；diff 事后列出文件增删改、按主键对齐的行级增删改，以及 schema 有没有被动过——全部机械可核验。
body.en: checkpoint records each container's filesystem baseline plus a database snapshot; diff then lists file changes, row-level insertions/updates/deletions aligned by primary key, and whether the schema moved — all mechanically checkable.

body.zh: 同一份种子必然得到同一个指纹；改数据或只改 schema（加索引、去掉 NOT NULL），指纹同样改变。状态是否被动过，一条哈希就能核验。
body.en: The same seed always yields the same fingerprint; changing data or only the schema — an added index, a dropped NOT NULL — moves it too. Whether the state moved becomes a checkable hash.

caption.zh: 播种 → 定格 → 对比，一条机械链路
caption.en: Seed, freeze, compare — one mechanical chain

body.zh: agent 自己搭的验证环境没有基线，也就没有审计。worldcheck 把环境的起点变成工具播种的世界，把验证前的状态变成工具打下的检查点：compose 定义服务，seed.sql 定义状态，checkpoint 定格基线，diff 回答变化。
body.en: An agent-built verification environment has no baseline, hence no audit. worldcheck turns the environment's origin into a tool-seeded world and the pre-verification state into a tool-made checkpoint: compose defines the services, seed.sql defines the state, checkpoint freezes the baseline, diff answers what moved.

body.zh: 清空卷、等数据库就绪、灌入种子、抓取状态、写下指纹；验证前记录文件基线与数据库快照；验证后重新采集并对比。没有一步依赖 agent 的自觉，全部由 docker CLI 与 pg_dump 完成。
body.en: Reset volumes, wait for the database, apply the seed, capture the state, write the fingerprint; record the filesystem baseline and database snapshot before verification; re-capture and compare after. No step relies on the agent's good faith — the docker CLI and pg_dump do all of it.

alt.zh: up 命令的五个步骤与种子编辑验收说明
alt.en: The five steps of up plus the seed-edit acceptance note

title.zh: 单个二进制，一个外部依赖

body.zh: worldcheck 通过 stdio 调用 docker CLI，不用 SDK、不与 daemon 版本耦合；没有常驻进程，没有自己的数据库。行级对比按主键对齐，主键从数据库目录里读，不是猜的。
body.en: worldcheck drives the docker CLI over stdio — no SDK, no daemon-version coupling; no server process, no database of its own. Rows are aligned by primary key, read from the database catalog rather than guessed.

alt.zh: shell 到 compose 项目的架构分层图
alt.en: Architecture layers from the shell to the compose project

body.zh: 完整 pg_dump（schema + 数据）的输出，去掉注释、空行和带随机 token 的 psql 元命令，剩余行排序后取 sha256。同一种子必同指纹；改数据或只改 schema 也必变。
body.en: The full pg_dump output (schema plus data) drops comments, blank lines and psql meta-commands carrying a per-dump random token; the remaining lines are sorted and hashed with sha256. Same seed, same fingerprint; a data change or a schema-only change moves it too.

title.zh: 一次真实的检查点会话

note.zh: 输出逐字来自 docs/demo-results.json 记录的真实运行。
note.en: Output lines are verbatim from the recorded run in docs/demo-results.json.

body.zh: 清空旧世界，起服务，等数据库就绪，灌种子，写清单。
body.en: Wipe the old world, start services, wait for the database, apply the seed, write the manifest.

steps.output:

  service db (postgres:16-alpine)
  table projects: 3 rows
  table tasks: 6 rows
  table users: 4 rows
manifest written to manifest.json
seeded-state fingerprint: bbc332815fe79e0680b313ee0ce12ead8bb24cc39cf3e0d94533de00cf8e1b3d

body.zh: 验证前记录文件基线与数据库快照。
body.en: Record the filesystem baseline and the database snapshot before verification.

steps.output:
checkpoint t1 recorded
  filesystem baseline: 4 path(s) across 1 container(s)
  database snapshot:   sha256:bbc332815fe7
  record:              checkpoints/t1.json

body.zh: 服务、表行数与指纹，全部来自 manifest.json。
body.en: Services, row counts and the fingerprint, all from manifest.json.

steps.output:
world      postgres-starter
project    wc-postgres-starter
seed       seed.sql (sha256:2a2fb32475ae)
database   app
provisioned 2026-10-22 19:28:43 UTC (worldcheck 0.2.0)

SERVICE  IMAGE
db       postgres:16-alpine

TABLE     ROWS
projects  3
tasks     6
users     4

fingerprint (sha256:pgdump-schema-and-data-sorted-lines)
  bbc332815fe79e0680b313ee0ce12ead8bb24cc39cf3e0d94533de00cf8e1b3d

body.zh: 模拟一个偷偷改自己 fixture 行、又在世界里留下文件的 agent。
body.en: Simulate an agent flipping its own fixture row and leaving a file behind in the world.

steps.command: docker compose -p wc-postgres-starter exec -T db psql -U postgres -d app -q -c 'UPDATE tasks SET done = true WHERE id = 6;'

body.zh: 变更对比当场列出那一条被改绿的行，以及 agent 留下的文件。
body.en: The diff lists exactly the row that was bent to green, plus the file the agent left behind.

steps.output:
checkpoint t1
mutations  files 1 added / 1 changed / 0 deleted; rows 0 inserted / 1 updated / 0 deleted; schema unchanged

KIND     CONTAINER                 PATH
ADDED    wc-postgres-starter-db-1  /tmp/agent-note
CHANGED  wc-postgres-starter-db-1  /tmp

KIND     ROW
UPDATED  tasks[id=6] = 6 | 3 | keep diffs mechanical | f  ->  6 | 3 | keep diffs mechanical | t

body.zh: 改一行种子重跑 up：指纹必然改变，且可复现。
body.en: Edit one seed line and re-run up: the fingerprint must change, reproducibly.

steps.command: echo 'UPDATE tasks SET done = true WHERE project_id = 2;' >> worlds/postgres-starter/seed.sql && worldcheck up --world worlds/postgres-starter

body.zh: 需要本机 Docker 在跑；无需任何配置文件。
body.en: Needs a running local Docker daemon; no config file anywhere.

limitations.zh: m3（`run` + worldcheck.html 对账报告）在本版本中是路线图桩命令。
limitations.en: m3 (`run` plus the worldcheck.html reconciliation report) is a roadmap stub in this release.

limitations.zh: diff 的文件部分是 `docker diff` 的原始视图，包含容器自身的运行期写入（Postgres 会改 /tmp 与数据目录）；行级增删改才是精确信号。
limitations.en: The filesystem half of a diff is the raw `docker diff` view, including the container's own runtime writes (a live Postgres rewrites /tmp and its data directory); the row deltas are the precise signal.

limitations.zh: worldcheck 只审计不回滚；diff 纯机械，无 LLM 判断；仅支持本地 Docker 与 Postgres。
limitations.en: worldcheck audits and does not rewind; diffs are purely mechanical, no LLM judgment; local Docker and Postgres only.
